comment: Coactivator p300/CBP binds and acetylates p53
GSK3β directly interacts with p53 after DNA damage and modulates its activity.
BRD7 N-terminus binds the C-terminus of TP53 and recruits EP300 to p53 target promoters.
RNaseH-II (containing RNASEH2A) used as a protein that does not interact with p53 in IP controls.
